characteristics.name: WHEEL OF FORTUNE
characteristics.rulesText:
*SWIFT Name a *RAM cost, then reveal the top card of your cyberdeck. If its *RAM cost is the named cost, install 1 *RAM running.
REVERSED draw 2.

reversal.normalText: Name a *RAM cost, then reveal the top card of your cyberdeck. If its *RAM cost is the named cost, install 1 *RAM running.
reversal.reversedText: Name a *RAM cost, then reveal the top card of your cyberdeck. If its *RAM cost is the named cost, draw 2.
